==Overview==
'''Section M''' is the third section the player will encounter. This section is quite barren, housing few entities. The entity difficulty is vast, with [[M-60]] rushing by and checking a x marked locker. The hardest entity, [[M-120]], can replicate a few entities from [[Section A]] and [[Section D]]. After reaching M-400, the next section can be found, [[Section E]].

==Strategies==
* The main difficulty of this section lies in majority of entities who can check/break lockers. It's recommended to learn each entity individually and/or find locker that entity cannot check/break beforehand.
* Always stay near a locker after after [[M-200]] passes, as he can block the spawn cue for [[M-22]].
* if [[M-200]] has passed, be prepared to run back when you open the door, as [[M-150]](White) may spawn

== Trivia ==
* '''M Section''' is the only normally encounterable section (this means that you can encounter it without any modifier or special action), that have the less '''I variations''' entities, with only 3 entities that have '''I variations''', that are [[M-60]] ([[M-60i]]), [[M-120]] ([[M-120i]] | Upcoming) and [[M-70]] ([[M-70i]] | Admin exclusive and/or not implemented in-game).
* [https://youtu.be/NvWbZ1qtFe0?si=ZzhIS3y_N-dBaF7r Update Executive Teaser 8]
